headline: High-risk default data leakage and cascading-error pathways exist; Langflow’s broad filesystem/network/tooling can expose Cognee’s support and personal data.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Cognee ingests documents, workflows, and support history, while Langflow can chain multiple agents and wire tools into flows. That creates a plausible path where attacker-controlled content in Cognee outputs is treated as instructions by Langflow. The pair lacks explicit provenance or isolation guarantees, so uncertainty pushes this above low.
conditions: IF Langflow flow nodes consume Cognee-generated text as prompts or tool instructions
IF Cognee ingests untrusted documents that Langflow later reuses without provenance checks
mitigations: Add a fixed prompt separator and instruction/data delimiter in the flow
Require a human review step before any Langflow node executes Cognee text
Tag Cognee outputs as untrusted metadata in the flow
Disable automatic chaining from Cognee outputs into tool-using nodes
requires-engineering: add provenance tracking between agents

B_data_leakage.rationale: Cognee touches personal data, finance data, and support history, and Langflow reads/writes server filesystem files and sends data to model providers or arbitrary HTTP services. In default deployments, Langflow can therefore exfiltrate sensitive Cognee data through flow components or uploaded files. The blast radius includes irreversible disclosure, so high is warranted.
conditions: IF Cognee outputs are passed into Langflow file inputs or HTTP-connected components
IF Langflow flows are configured to send those inputs to external model providers or HTTP services
mitigations: Restrict Langflow flows to local-only components
Remove sensitive data classes from any Cognee-to-Langflow handoff
Turn off file upload paths for flows handling Cognee outputs
Use a separate tenant or workspace for sensitive Cognee data
requires-engineering: enforce DLP/redaction before Langflow egress

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Cognee supports multiple instances with session memory, and Langflow supports multiple instances with server-side shared state plus unrestricted filesystem write. Both can mutate shared resources, but Langflow’s write access and server-side stores make conflicts likely if they target the same workspace or files. The pair lacks locking guarantees, so high is appropriate.
conditions: IF both agents operate on the same directory, database, or server-side store
IF Cognee session outputs are written into paths that Langflow also reads or writes
mitigations: Separate the agents into distinct workspaces
Make shared paths read-only for one agent
Serialize writes through a single orchestrator
Snapshot shared state before each run
requires-engineering: add file/database locking around shared resources

D_cascading_error.rationale: Langflow’s graph-based flows can chain multiple agents and tools, so Cognee outputs may become authoritative inputs downstream. Cognee produces decisions, workflows, and successful implementations, which Langflow can then route into actions without a built-in verification step. That makes misclassification or hallucination propagate into real actions, so high fits.
conditions: IF Langflow uses Cognee outputs as inputs to action-taking nodes
IF no verification or approval node is inserted between Cognee and downstream tools
mitigations: Insert a validation node before any action-taking step
Require approval for any flow that consumes Cognee outputs
Limit downstream nodes to read-only summarization
Log and diff Cognee outputs before execution
requires-engineering: add automated fact-checking against source data

E_compliance.rationale: Cognee explicitly touches personal data, finance data, and support history, while Langflow stores per-flow credentials and can send data to external model providers or HTTP services. If EU or regulated data is routed through Langflow without a DPA or residency controls, the pair can create a compliance breach. The profiles do not show matching safeguards, so high is justified.
conditions: IF regulated personal or finance data from Cognee is routed through Langflow flows
IF Langflow components send that data to non-approved external services or retain it beyond policy
mitigations: Block regulated data from Langflow flows
Review retention settings for Langflow stores
Store credentials in a separate secrets manager
Restrict flows to approved regional endpoints
requires-engineering: implement residency and retention enforcement
